container: background-color: #f7f7f5; padding: 36px 14px; letter-spacing: 0.3px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
p: font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.75; color: #141414; margin: 0 0 16px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
h2: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: #141414; margin: 0 0 20px; text-align: left
h2_first: font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; color: #141414; margin: 0 0 20px; text-align: left
h3: font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; color: #141414; text-align: left; margin: 26px 0 12px
blockquote: background-color: #ececea; padding: 14px 18px; margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.75; color: #141414; font-weight: 600; text-align: left; border-left: 4px solid #e03131
code: color: #141414; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace; letter-spacing: 0
inline_code: background-color: #ececea; color: #e03131; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 0; font-size: 13.5px; letter-spacing: 0; font-family: Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, 'Courier New', monospace
list_item: font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.75; color: #141414; margin: 0 0 10px; text-align: left; overflow-wrap: break-word
th: background-color: #141414; color: #f7f7f5; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid #d9d9d5; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 14px; text-align: left
td: border: 1px solid #d9d9d5; padding: 9px 11px; font-size: 14px; color: #141414; text-align: left
h2_text_style: display: inline-block; background-color: #141414; color: #f7f7f5; padding: 8px 16px; letter-spacing: 2px; border-radius: 0
